6823-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
6823-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

2317-4050-6664-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Repeat.

529-5223-5641-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4247-4659-5003-6644.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Treasures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

5777-6716-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
5777-6716-7810.description:
Activate Glimmer Bairn by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Glimmer Bairn ability
Repeat.

5640-5917-7895.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
5640-5917-7895.description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, targeting Little Bear.
Resolve the copy of The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, creating a token copy of Little Bear that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
When Little Bear enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping The Jolly Balloon Man.
Resolve the Jolly Ballon Man ability from step 2, creating a token copy of the mana-producing creature that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
Activate the mana-producing creature token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

348-1152-2393-2992-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-2393-2992-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Sifter of Skulls triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

855-2021-2060-7704.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

3532-5078-6595-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyse Hext's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

64-676-1987.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
64-676-1987.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
64-676-1987.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-676-1987.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2556-4377-7631.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2104-2187-5144.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Possessed Skaab and exiling Ephemerate.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1251-3259-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-7357.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

339-677-5686-7297.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

539-2292-7035.description:
Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Earthbending Student
When Earthbending Student dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4375-5226-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

1856-3490-4659-6783.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1856-3490-4659-6783.description:
Activate Junk Golem by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability triggers, pairing it and the Servo.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3168-4484-4871-5147-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3168-4484-4871-5147-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3168-4484-4871-5147-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2835-5147-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2835-5147-6249--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1479-1659-4826-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1659-4826-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Seed the Land trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

277-1170-1645-2499-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1762-2921-4871-5173-5626.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Wilhelt's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Wilhelt trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token with decayed.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing the Zombie token, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

997-2060-2577-3602.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
997-2060-2577-3602.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1459-2713-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control except Galadriel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Galadriel triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Galadriel.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead choose any of Galadriel's modes.

1308-1766-2043-5295.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Thran Dynamo that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate both Thran Dynamo tokens' abilities by tapping them, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2056-2160-2649-3395-4406.notablePrerequisites: You control and own an additional non-Human creature.
2056-2160-2649-3395-4406.description:
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, mutating it onto a non-Human creature.
The Vadrok mutated creature's mutate ability triggers, allowing you to cast Chance for Glory from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Saheeli triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve Chance for Glory, giving creatures you control indestructible, taking an extra turn after this one, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {U} and tapping it, returning the components of the Vadrok mutated creature from the battlefield to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, if this is an extra turn from Chance for Glory, Chance for Glory's delayed triggered ability triggers.
In response, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, ending the turn and exiling the triggered ability.
Repeat each turn.
